why_not: I already paid for a mass-DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, so anything that sends DMs for me from my own Instagram makes me flinch, however nicely it's worded. There are zero results or case studies, and a refund of $147 doesn't give me back an account that got restricted.

I already pay a setter who works the inbox, and nobody has shown me this booking a single call. I'd run the free 10-DM preview out of curiosity, but I wouldn't put a card in on a promise with zero published results.

I'd probably poke at the 10 free sample DMs and maybe even start the trial, but I wouldn't be paying $147 a month. Other Instagram DM tools run a third to a quarter of that, and I'm an SDR working a client's leads out of a Google Sheet, not an agency owner with a margin to spend on tools.
$147 a month is three or four times what other Instagram DM tools charge, and I'm under $5k a month myself. I haven't landed a client from this yet, so I'm not paying that for a maybe.

I'm making about $2.6k a month and I have zero clients on the books right now, so $147 a month is a real bite before I've landed anything. I'd play with the free 10-DM preview, but I wouldn't put a card in until I have cash coming in.

I do my outreach the way my course taught me, with the tools it told me to use and my leads in a Google Sheet, and nobody in that circle has mentioned this tool. My DMs aren't really the problem anyway, my offer is, so paying $147 a month to send more of them doesn't fix what's actually broken.
why_yes: I burn one to three hours a day typing openers by hand and it dies whenever client work gets busy, so $147 is nothing against that time. I only start the trial if the 10 sample DMs it writes for my niche sound like a person and not a template.

I burn one to three hours a day typing openers by hand and it dies the second client work gets busy, so $147 to get that time back is nothing at my revenue. The 10 free sample DMs before I enter a card plus the 7-day trial means I can judge the writing quality myself for free.

The money is nothing to me, and my bio call link barely gets clicked, so I need a way to start conversations. I'd run it on a second account only, after seeing the 10 sample DMs in my niche are good, because the ban refund gives me back a month and not my storefront.
